requirements.title: Freeze an explicit application profile
requirements.acceptance: Profile records every hard constraint, units, conditions, evidence rule and decision owner; proposed values are distinguishable.

requirements.title: Verify the controlling AWF
requirements.acceptance: Target-project conformance references the inspected 1.9.1 commit/manifest, actual installation state and revision-3 schema; it does not claim live readiness from documentation.

requirements.title: Separate engineering and scientific outcomes
requirements.acceptance: A negative or inconclusive research fixture closes with an honest research outcome and cannot be labeled qualified fluid.

requirements.title: Record responsibilities and resource limits
requirements.acceptance: Responsibilities and separate AWF/research resource envelopes identify actual owners or pending assignments; no paid action is admitted on a null/unapproved budget.

requirements.title: Run core workflows without notebook state
requirements.acceptance: A fresh headless process executes the pinned fixture and produces its expected outputs without opening a notebook.

requirements.title: Validate all inter-component contracts
requirements.acceptance: Malformed, missing-version and wrong-unit payloads are rejected with machine-readable reason codes.

requirements.title: Capture execution provenance
requirements.acceptance: Each completed run links its code, configuration, data, dependencies and outputs through verifiable hashes.

requirements.title: Separate optional capability availability
requirements.acceptance: Missing external software produces an unavailable-capability result while the offline core fixture remains runnable.

requirements.title: Preserve source provenance
requirements.acceptance: Every accepted observation resolves to an original source record and locator; untraceable inputs are quarantined.

requirements.title: Preserve measurement semantics
requirements.acceptance: Fixtures distinguish pressure basis, temperature, frequency, phase, composition basis, uncertainty and censoring.

requirements.title: Deduplicate without destroying conflicting evidence
requirements.acceptance: Republished measurements are grouped; disagreeing observations remain individually addressable with reconciliation history.

requirements.title: Keep evidence classes separate
requirements.acceptance: Measured, derived, simulated, predicted and extracted-unverified records cannot be silently interchanged.

requirements.title: Review machine-extracted evidence
requirements.acceptance: An extraction without a verifiable locator or with wrong units cannot enter the accepted training snapshot.

requirements.title: Audit data coverage and exclusions
requirements.acceptance: Report independent identities and sources by property/condition/family, with every excluded record and reason retained.

requirements.title: Version chemical normalization
requirements.acceptance: Stereo, salt, tautomer, fragment and ambiguous-product fixtures follow the declared policy and retain original identities.

requirements.title: Represent samples and formulations
requirements.acceptance: Component ordering is canonicalized; mass and mole fractions remain distinguishable; sample batches retain separate identities.

requirements.title: Version descriptors and capabilities
requirements.acceptance: Feature schemas and tool versions are fixed; unsupported structures and failed calculations yield explicit nonnumeric states.

requirements.title: Freeze eligible candidate universes
requirements.acceptance: Candidate snapshots contain availability/novelty status and provenance; comparisons use the same declared universe.

requirements.title: Implement a physical reference baseline
requirements.acceptance: Reference calculations reproduce independently specified fixtures within declared tolerances and label out-of-range evaluations.

requirements.title: Evaluate the feasible region
requirements.acceptance: Report constraint conflicts, missing evidence and observed trade-offs without silently relaxing the target.

requirements.title: Model mixture phase behavior explicitly
requirements.acceptance: Core schemas/rejection fixtures distinguish mixtures correctly; enabling the conditional MIX lane additionally requires validated bubble/dew, composition and phase checks.

requirements.title: Preserve system-dependent endpoints
requirements.acceptance: Thermal and electrical performance records include required rig/method context; unsupported proxy substitutions are rejected.

requirements.title: Prevent correlated-label leakage
requirements.acceptance: Split audit detects overlap in substances, measurement groups and protected chemical families according to the declared test.

requirements.title: Freeze information available to evaluation
requirements.acceptance: Predictions and rankings are committed before holdout disclosure; post-disclosure changes require a new evaluation version.

requirements.title: Compare valid baselines
requirements.acceptance: The predeclared metric contract, grouped evaluation and uncertainty meet section 10 promotion rules or return a bounded negative/inconclusive decision.

requirements.title: Replay sequential policies honestly
requirements.acceptance: Replay reveals only requested hidden observations and charges specified costs; unavailable endpoints remain unavailable.

requirements.title: Report inconclusive evaluations
requirements.acceptance: Insufficient coverage or precision yields INCONCLUSIVE with reasons rather than a numerical pass by default.

requirements.title: Train reproducible baseline property models
requirements.acceptance: Training runs produce model artifacts, model cards, selected hyperparameters and reproducible evaluation outputs.

requirements.title: Condition predictions on physical context
requirements.acceptance: Requests with unsupported temperature/pressure/phase return an explicit applicability result rather than unqualified values.

requirements.title: Calibrate uncertainty and abstention
requirements.acceptance: Report interval coverage and width on declared chemical-group holdouts and demonstrate abstention on out-of-domain fixtures.

requirements.title: Handle joint constraints and missing properties
requirements.acceptance: Correlated-property fixtures cannot be evaluated by an undeclared independence assumption; unavailable endpoints remain unknown.

requirements.title: Compare physics-assisted learning fairly
requirements.acceptance: An ablation separates the effect of extra information from the effect of the learning method and reports negative results.

requirements.title: Declare engine capabilities and requirements
requirements.acceptance: Adapter reports supported chemistry/methods/versions and required runtime/licence; unsupported requests fail before expensive execution.

requirements.title: Validate calculations against references
requirements.acceptance: Each enabled property/method has a reference comparison and convergence checks; single-molecule energy is not relabeled as a liquid property.

requirements.title: Bound computation and handle failures
requirements.acceptance: Timeout, nonconvergence, cancellation and deterministic unsupported-method fixtures terminate visibly without unbounded retries.

requirements.title: Avoid invalid cross-engine reuse
requirements.acceptance: Cache and interoperability checks reject mismatched method, geometry, temperature, parameterization or engine version.

requirements.title: Evaluate hard constraints without compensation
requirements.acceptance: One hard failure cannot be offset by favorable objectives; an unknown hard endpoint cannot count as a confirmed pass.

requirements.title: Maintain traceable screening decisions
requirements.acceptance: Every included, rejected and deferred candidate has profile/filter versions, reasons and evidence references.

requirements.title: Generate interpretable trade-off sets
requirements.acceptance: Report objective directions, conditions, uncertainty and nondominated candidates; empty feasible sets remain valid outputs.

requirements.title: Separate exploration from qualification
requirements.acceptance: A candidate proposed for learning is visibly distinguished from one with sufficient physical evidence for the profile.

requirements.title: Select measurement actions under cost
requirements.acceptance: A proposal identifies candidate, test, conditions, fidelity, prerequisites and estimated resource consumption.

requirements.title: Compare sequential selection policies
requirements.acceptance: Run equal-information/equal-budget comparisons against random, fixed physical ranking and greedy alternatives.

requirements.title: Respect batching and pending work
requirements.acceptance: Pending or completed equivalent actions are not accidentally purchased twice; setup and availability constraints are enforced.

requirements.title: Reproduce the selection history
requirements.acceptance: A decision can be regenerated from its recorded information snapshot, seed, policy, profile and pending-action state.

requirements.title: Specify executable measurement requests
requirements.acceptance: Requests contain sample IDs, methods, conditions, controls, quantities, raw-data requirements and return schemas.

requirements.title: Validate experimental intake
requirements.acceptance: Unknown sample IDs, failed controls and missing raw-data references are quarantined with visible reason codes.

requirements.title: Characterize relevant failure mechanisms
requirements.acceptance: Protocols cover thermal/electrical performance, relevant materials exposure and composition changes for the activated lane.

requirements.title: Preserve protocol deviations and outcomes
requirements.acceptance: Failed or deviating tests remain in the experiment register; inclusion/exclusion decisions are explicit.

requirements.title: Freeze prospective comparison design
requirements.acceptance: Campaign protocol freezes endpoints, information sharing, budget and a power/precision assessment; an underpowered pilot is labelled exploratory.

requirements.title: Track actual experiment resources
requirements.acceptance: Report costs, failures, elapsed time and completed measurements for every arm, including unsuccessful procurement.

requirements.title: Evaluate prospective scientific outcomes
requirements.acceptance: Final campaign report distinguishes discovery, improvement, no demonstrated advantage and inconclusive results.

requirements.title: Produce candidate evidence dossiers
requirements.acceptance: Each dossier resolves every material claim to measured, calculated or predicted evidence with conditions and gaps.

requirements.title: Produce gate decisions with rationale
requirements.acceptance: A gate report states pass/stop/inconclusive, evidence, applicable scope and unresolved dependencies.

requirements.title: Create reproducible research exports
requirements.acceptance: Markdown and JSON outputs agree on candidate IDs, constraints, metrics and scientific status.

requirements.title: Gate generative and RL extensions
requirements.acceptance: An extension proposal names the validated scorer, bounded chemistry/action space, baseline and experimental validation plan.

requirements.title: Gate learned simulation extensions
requirements.acceptance: An ML-potential/custom-acceleration proposal identifies a measured bottleneck, domain, reference checks and cost-benefit test.

requirements.title: Package independent rerun evidence
requirements.acceptance: A second clean environment runs the declared reference workflow from pinned inputs and records agreement or documented limitations.

requirements.title: Complete requirements-to-evidence traceability
requirements.acceptance: Every requirement applicable to the declared release increment maps to work packages, artifacts and verification evidence; later/disabled capabilities retain explicit planned/blocked status and claim restrictions.

requirements.title: Prepare AWF handoff without bypassing approval
requirements.acceptance: Handoff binds the actual adopted 1.9.1 policy, current candidate review/closeout evidence and owner status; compatibility inspection alone is not installation or authorization.

requirements.title: Implement cross-runtime operation envelopes
requirements.acceptance: Golden request/response fixtures agree across Wolfram and Python, reject malformed/status-inconsistent payloads and propagate required-check failures.

requirements.title: Preserve transitive lineage and corrections
requirements.acceptance: A corrected or derived observation updates dependent-staleness reports; seeded target-derived features and republished labels cannot leak into the holdout.

requirements.title: Account for actions and unknown outcomes
requirements.acceptance: Duplicate active actions are rejected, unknown submissions are reconciled without resubmission and reservations/actual charges remain consistent under interruption.

requirements.title: Verify artifact recovery and scientific claims
requirements.acceptance: A restored decision resolves its required artifacts/hashes; missing physical evidence or inaccessible dependencies cannot be presented as a qualified or publicly reproducible result.
